Job Opportunities

Our success as a leader in Metro Vancouver real estate depends on hiring great people. If you feel your skills and motivation would be a valuable addition to our dedicated team, we would love to hear from you.

As one of few residential homebuilders in British Columbia to have its own sales, marketing, interior design, construction and customer service departments all under one roof, Polygon cares about serving our customers every step of the way. That’s why we look for especially dedicated and hard-working professionals to join our team. If a rewarding career at one of Metro Vancouver’s top homebuilders is what you’re after, check the available job listings below or send your resumé and cover letter to: careers@polyhomes.com
